title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future  deals in doubt
lede: Nvidia now values its stakes in private companies at $65.5 billion, up from $22 billion in January, but its interim CEO is signalling a more cautious approach to new deals.

points: It put $16 billion into equities last quarter and $58 billion over nine months, against $5 billion over the same stretch a year earlier.
PitchBook counts nearly 350 startups backed since late 2023, from Anthropic and OpenAI to neoclouds such as Lambda, Nscale and Crusoe.
Nvidia also carries $118 billion in guarantees, $105 billion of it for OpenAI's Ohio data center.
Kress said future investments and guarantees will be rigorously evaluated, and excess free cash flow will go back to shareholders.
Investors told TechCrunch they expect fewer new bets and smaller follow-on checks.

sections.text: Nvidia has been one of the largest backers of AI labs and GPU clouds; a pullback would tighten the capital available to startups building models and infrastructure.
